attribute.name: domain
attribute.expr: eval: " self.product.id = " + (product?.id ?: 0) + " AND ( self.lotFournisseur.supplier.id = " + (_parent?.partner?.id ?: stockMove?.partner?.id ?: 0) + " OR self.lotFournisseur IS NULL ) AND ( EXISTS ( SELECT sll.id FROM StockLocationLine sll WHERE sll.trackingNumber.id = self.id AND sll.detailsStockLocation.id = ${fromStockLocation?.id} ) OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT stockLocationLine.id FROM StockLocationLine stockLocationLine WHERE stockLocationLine.trackingNumber.id = self.id ) ) "
